name: Kyoto
oneLineFragment: Gion alleyways at 5 AM before the paper lanterns go out.
narrativeStory:
Before the delivery vans and tourist crowds arrive, the stone paving of Gion and Shirakawa holds a gentle sheen of morning damp.

The scent of damp hinoki cypress, charcoal grills, and moss gardens drifts through bamboo lattices. Eleven medium-format negatives capturing the stillness between old traditions and passing seasons.
subtitle: Higashiyama Footpaths • Machiya Architecture
introLines: Wet granite flags reflecting paper lanterns.
Cypress wood sliding doors shut tight against the dawn.
Eleven exposures of quiet urban architecture.

frames.caption: Solitary pedestrian in Gion alleyway at 5am
Sagano bamboo grove murmuring under light autumn drizzle

Raked gravel and moss islands inside secluded temple courtyard
Shirakawa canal willows brushing stone footbridge at dusk
